contract: This enabling story has no independent accepted requirement identifier and contributes to G-007. G-007 succeeds when generation, compact generation, and refinement output formats consistently declare scalar requirement_id; deterministic compact generation, independent rejection, refinement, and independent approval preserve the accepted identifier; both reviewer negative controls fail for their intended reasons; scoped executable statement coverage exceeds 90 percent; and protected schema-recovery, human-boundary, commit-ownership, and retained-budget regressions pass. Verify that repository outcome through the implementation story's complete verification script and repository-local evidence. Account separately for D2 with supported delivery evidence: documentation or passing repository checks cannot satisfy an unverified default-branch merge. Inspect and verify only this OpenExec checkout. Do not read retained /tmp artifacts or another checkout. Do not declare D2 satisfied solely from reviewer prose, checkout notes, or the observed Agent Console revision. Preserve native candidate provenance and existing human boundaries.
repair_verification:
set -eu
go test ./internal/planner/ -run 'TestAllPlanningPathsRespectSchemaAndCommitOwnership|TestEnablingRequirementSurvivesRefinementAndReview|TestCompactRequirementIdentityThroughReviewAndRefinement' -count=1 -v
bash scripts/verify-compact-requirement-coverage.sh
bash scripts/verify-compact-requirement-mutations.sh
go test ./internal/planner/ ./pkg/manager/ -count=1
make test
make compat-test
make type-check
bash scripts/verify-compact-requirement-evidence.sh repair
scope_policy: Additive only: full executable function bodies; never remove functions or branches to obtain >90% statement coverage. Include newly introduced production helpers in planner and manager. Prompt constants use separate format assertions and both negative controls. Verification-only Python helpers are tested separately, not included in product Go coverage.
